description: This file defines the 'XGraphicsPdfRenderer' class, which implements rendering operations for PDF graphics within the PdfSharp library. It includes methods for drawing various shapes, images, and text onto PDF pages, manages graphic states, transformations, and clipping, and handles content stream generation for PDF files.

classes.name: XGraphicsPdfRenderer
classes.description: Implements rendering operations for PDF content, including drawing shapes, images, and text, managing graphic states and transformations, and producing the content streams for PDF pages within the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: DrawLine
methods.description: Draws a line between two points using the specified pen.

methods.name: DrawLines
methods.description: Draws a series of connected lines through an array of points.

methods.name: DrawBezier
methods.description: Draws a cubic Bézier curve defined by start point, control points, and end point.

methods.name: DrawBeziers
methods.description: Draws multiple Bézier curves to form complex shapes.

methods.name: DrawCurve
methods.description: Draws a cardinal spline through a set of points with specified tension.

methods.name: DrawArc
methods.description: Draws an elliptical arc defined by bounding rectangle, start angle, and sweep angle.

methods.name: DrawRectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with optional stroke and fill.

methods.name: DrawRectangles
methods.description: Draws multiple rectangles.

methods.name: DrawRoundedRectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with rounded corners.

methods.name: DrawEllipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse inscribed within specified rectangle.

methods.name: DrawPolygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon shape connecting multiple points with fill options.

methods.name: DrawPie
methods.description: Draws a pie shape, which is a section of an ellipse.

methods.name: DrawClosedCurve
methods.description: Draws a smooth closed curve through given points.

methods.name: DrawPath
methods.description: Draws a complex path described by an 'XGraphicsPath' object.

methods.name: DrawString
methods.description: Draws text string within a specified rectangle, with formatting options.

methods.name: DrawString (with typeface)
methods.description: Draws text using a specific glyph typeface (not implemented).

methods.name: DrawImage
methods.description: Draws an image or form at specified position and size; handles PDF form objects and images.

methods.name: AppendPath
methods.description: Appends the content of a GraphicsPath or CoreGraphicsPath object to the PDF content stream, translating the path points and types into PDF path operations.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a string value to the internal content buffer.

methods.name: AppendFormatArgs
methods.description: Appends formatted text with invariant culture formatting.

methods.name: AppendFormatString
methods.description: Appends a formatted string containing a single string argument.

methods.name: AppendFormatFont
methods.description: Appends a formatted string involving font data.

methods.name: AppendFormatInt
methods.description: Appends a formatted integer value.

methods.name: AppendFormatDouble
methods.description: Appends a formatted double value.

methods.name: AppendFormatPoint
methods.description: Appends a formatted point after transforming from world to view coordinates.

methods.name: AppendFormatRect
methods.description: Appends a formatted rectangle, transforming the top-left point from world to view space.

methods.name: AppendFormat3Points
methods.description: Appends a formatted string of three points, transforming each from world to view space.

methods.name: AppendFormat
methods.description: Appends a formatted string for a point.

methods.name: AppendFormat
methods.description: Overload that appends a string with specific x and y coordinates and a string.

methods.name: AppendFormatImage
methods.description: Appends image placement parameters, transforming position from world to view space.

methods.name: AppendStrokeFill
methods.description: Appends the path stroke and fill commands based on pen, brush, and fill mode; closes path if specified.

methods.name: BeginPage
methods.description: Initializes the content stream for a new page, setting up the coordinate transformation based on page direction and size, and saving initial graphic state.

methods.name: EndPage
methods.description: Ends the content stream, restores graphic states, and finalizes the page drawing, removing trailing line feeds.

methods.name: BeginGraphicMode
methods.description: Switches the content stream into graphic mode from text mode.

methods.name: BeginTextMode
methods.description: Switches the content stream into text mode from graphic mode.

methods.name: IsInTextMode
methods.description: Checks if currently in text mode.

methods.name: Realize
methods.description: Sets the specified pen and brush as the current graphics objects, ensuring the graphics state reflects these changes.

methods.name: Realize
methods.description: Sets the specified pen as current.

methods.name: Realize
methods.description: Sets the specified brush as current.

methods.name: Realize
methods.description: Configures the current font and brush for text rendering.

methods.name: AdjustTdOffset
methods.description: Adjusts the text position offset, optionally skewing for italic simulation.

methods.name: Realize(XImage)
methods.description: Makes an image or form object the current graphic object and returns its resource name.

methods.name: RealizeTransform
methods.description: Applies the current transformation matrix if it is not yet realized.

methods.name: WorldToView
methods.description: Transforms a point from Windows space to PDF coordinate space, considering the current graphic state and page size.
